prompts.title: Persona Builder
prompts.description: Generate a user persona for a fintech app, export as JSON for React handoff. Include demographics, tech proficiency, goals, pain points, and preferred interaction patterns. Format output as TypeScript interface for developer integration.

prompts.title: Interview Script Generator
prompts.description: Create a comprehensive user interview script for a SaaS dashboard. Include warm-up questions, task-based scenarios, follow-up probes, and closing questions. Export as Markdown with time allocations for 45-minute sessions.

prompts.title: Competitive Analysis Matrix
prompts.description: Design a competitive analysis comparing 5 project management tools. Include feature comparison, UX patterns, pricing models, and tech stack (React vs Vue). Output as CSV for data visualization in Tableau or D3.js.

prompts.title: Journey Map Framework
prompts.description: Create a customer journey map for an e-commerce checkout flow. Map touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities. Include API endpoints and state management considerations for React/Redux implementation.

prompts.title: Survey Design Template
prompts.description: Design a UX research survey for mobile app satisfaction. Include Likert scales, NPS questions, and open-ended feedback. Export as JSON schema for integration with Typeform or Google Forms API.

prompts.title: Card Sorting Analysis
prompts.description: Analyze card sorting results for IA optimization. Process 50+ participant responses, identify patterns using clustering algorithms, and output navigation structure as JSON tree for React Router implementation.

prompts.title: Heuristic Evaluation Checklist
prompts.description: Create a Nielsen's 10 heuristics evaluation checklist for a web app. Include severity ratings, component-level annotations, and export findings as GitHub issues with dev-ready descriptions and Figma links.

prompts.title: Analytics Dashboard Requirements
prompts.description: Define analytics tracking requirements for a React app. Specify event names, properties, user flows, and integration points for Google Analytics 4 or Mixpanel. Output as TypeScript event schema.

prompts.title: Empathy Map Workshop
prompts.description: Facilitate an empathy mapping session for healthcare app users. Document what users say, think, do, and feel. Structure output as Miro board JSON export or FigJam-compatible format.

prompts.title: Research Repository Setup
prompts.description: Structure a UX research repository using Notion or Airtable. Define schemas for storing insights, tagging methodologies, participant data, and linking to Figma prototypes. Export as API-ready JSON structure.

prompts.title: WCAG AA Compliance Audit
prompts.description: Conduct WCAG 2.1 AA audit for a React component library. Check color contrast ratios (4.5:1 minimum), test keyboard navigation, verify ARIA labels. Output as accessibility.json with component-level fixes and Tailwind utility suggestions.

prompts.title: ARIA Pattern Implementation
prompts.description: Implement ARIA roles, states, and properties for a custom dropdown component. Include aria-expanded, aria-labelledby, and keyboard handlers (Enter, Space, Escape). Export as React hook with TypeScript types.

prompts.title: Color Contrast Calculator
prompts.description: Calculate WCAG-compliant color palettes for a design system. Test primary, secondary, and accent colors against white/black backgrounds. Output as Tailwind config with contrast ratios and hex values.

prompts.title: Keyboard Navigation Guide
prompts.description: Design comprehensive keyboard navigation for a SaaS app. Map Tab order, focus indicators, skip links, and shortcuts (Cmd+K for search). Document as React Context implementation with useKeyboard hook.

prompts.title: Screen Reader Testing Protocol
prompts.description: Create testing protocol for NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver. Include test scripts, expected announcements, and failure criteria. Export results as JSON for CI/CD integration with axe-core and Pa11y.

prompts.title: Alt Text Generator
prompts.description: Generate context-aware alt text for UI images, icons, and infographics. Distinguish decorative (alt='') vs informative images. Output as JSON mapping for React components with i18n support.

prompts.title: Form Accessibility Audit
prompts.description: Audit form accessibility with proper labels, error messaging, and validation. Implement aria-invalid, aria-describedby, and live regions. Export as React Hook Form schema with Zod validation.

prompts.title: Motion Reduction Support
prompts.description: Implement prefers-reduced-motion for animations. Replace transitions with instant state changes, pause autoplay videos. Export as CSS-in-JS with Tailwind variants and Framer Motion configs.

prompts.title: Touch Target Optimization
prompts.description: Optimize touch targets for mobile (44x44px minimum). Audit buttons, links, and interactive elements. Output as Tailwind spacing utilities with responsive breakpoints for iOS and Android.

prompts.title: A11y Component Library
prompts.description: Build accessible component library documentation. Include ARIA patterns, keyboard shortcuts, and screen reader behavior. Export as Storybook with a11y addon integration and automated testing.

prompts.title: Interactive Prototype Export
prompts.description: Create high-fidelity Figma prototype with micro-interactions. Export to React components using Figma API, maintain auto-layout constraints as flexbox, and generate Tailwind classes from styles.

prompts.title: Component Variants System
prompts.description: Design component variants (primary, secondary, ghost) with Figma variants. Auto-generate TypeScript types and React props interface. Export as design tokens JSON for Style Dictionary processing.

prompts.title: Animation Specifications
prompts.description: Define animation library with easing curves, durations, and delays. Map to Framer Motion variants or CSS keyframes. Output as JSON config for consistent motion across React/Vue apps.

prompts.title: User Flow Diagram
prompts.description: Map user flows with decision points, error states, and success paths. Include API calls, loading states, and error boundaries. Export as React Router routes with lazy loading configuration.

prompts.title: Responsive Breakpoints
prompts.description: Define responsive breakpoints (mobile: 375px, tablet: 768px, desktop: 1440px). Create layout grid system with Figma auto-layout. Export as Tailwind config with custom screen sizes.

prompts.title: State Management Map
prompts.description: Visualize state management flow for complex UI. Map Redux actions, reducers, and selectors or Zustand stores. Export as TypeScript state machine with XState integration points.

prompts.title: Loading State Patterns
prompts.description: Design skeleton screens, spinners, and progress indicators. Include Suspense boundaries and error fallbacks for React. Export as reusable components with Next.js streaming SSR support.

prompts.title: Gesture Library Setup
prompts.description: Define gesture interactions (swipe, pinch, long-press) for mobile. Implement with React Spring or Framer Motion. Include haptic feedback triggers and iOS/Android platform differences.

prompts.title: Data Visualization Components
prompts.description: Prototype interactive charts with D3.js or Recharts. Define data structures, tooltip behaviors, and responsive scaling. Export as React components with TypeScript prop types.

prompts.title: Design Tokens Pipeline
prompts.description: Create design tokens from Figma (colors, typography, spacing). Set up Style Dictionary to transform tokens into CSS vars, Tailwind config, and iOS/Android native formats.

prompts.title: Usability Test Script
prompts.description: Write usability test script with 5 task scenarios. Include success criteria, time limits, and SUS questionnaire. Export as JSON for integration with UserTesting.com or Maze.design API.

prompts.title: A/B Test Configuration
prompts.description: Design A/B test for button color variants. Define success metrics (CTR, conversion), sample size calculation, and statistical significance (p < 0.05). Export as Optimizely or LaunchDarkly config JSON.

prompts.title: Remote Testing Setup
prompts.description: Configure remote usability testing with Zoom or UserZoom. Create moderator guide, participant consent forms, and session recording checklist. Export as testing playbook with GDPR compliance notes.

prompts.title: Task Success Metrics
prompts.description: Define KPIs for task completion: success rate, time-on-task, error count, and satisfaction scores. Create analytics dashboard mockup with Chart.js or Plotly integration specs.

prompts.title: Eye Tracking Analysis
prompts.description: Analyze eye tracking heatmaps for landing page optimization. Identify fixation points, scan patterns, and attention metrics. Export findings as annotated Figma frames with optimization recommendations.

prompts.title: Accessibility Testing Suite
prompts.description: Run automated accessibility tests with axe-core, Lighthouse, and Pa11y. Create CI/CD pipeline for regression testing. Export results as JSON with severity levels and remediation steps.

prompts.title: Mobile Device Testing
prompts.description: Test responsive design across iOS (iPhone 14 Pro) and Android (Pixel 7). Check touch targets, scroll performance, and orientation changes. Document findings with BrowserStack screenshots.

prompts.title: Card Sorting Results
prompts.description: Analyze open card sorting data from OptimalSort. Calculate agreement scores, create dendrogram visualizations, and recommend IA structure. Export as JSON sitemap for React Router configuration.

prompts.title: First Click Testing
prompts.description: Evaluate navigation effectiveness with first click tests. Measure click accuracy, task completion paths, and confusion points. Export heatmap data as SVG overlays for Figma integration.

prompts.title: Performance Benchmarking
prompts.description: Measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) for React app. Use Lighthouse CI in GitHub Actions. Set performance budgets and export metrics as JSON for monitoring dashboards.

prompts.title: Design Sprint Kickoff
prompts.description: Facilitate 5-day design sprint (Understand, Sketch, Decide, Prototype, Test). Create Miro board templates with lightning talks, crazy 8s, and voting sessions. Export sprint outputs as Notion pages.

prompts.title: Crazy 8s Workshop
prompts.description: Lead rapid ideation with 8 sketches in 8 minutes. Focus on mobile checkout flow improvements. Digitize sketches and export as Figma frames with annotation layers.

prompts.title: How Might We Questions
prompts.description: Generate HMW questions from user pain points. Convert '45% of users abandon checkout' into actionable design challenges. Export as FigJam sticky notes with voting dots.

prompts.title: SCAMPER Innovation
prompts.description: Apply SCAMPER method (Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to use, Eliminate, Reverse) to redesign navigation. Generate 7 alternative concepts and export as annotated wireframes.

prompts.title: Mind Mapping Session
prompts.description: Create mind map exploring 'future of remote collaboration tools'. Branch into features, tech stack (WebRTC, Three.js), and user needs. Export as interactive SVG with clickable nodes.

prompts.title: Analogous Inspiration
prompts.description: Find design patterns from gaming UIs (HP bars, skill trees) to apply to productivity apps. Create mood board with screenshots and Figma component translations.

prompts.title: Future State Visioning
prompts.description: Envision 2030 healthcare app with AR diagnostics, AI triage, and blockchain health records. Sketch concept screens and export as Figma prototype with futuristic UI kit.

prompts.title: Worst Idea Brainstorm
prompts.description: Generate intentionally terrible onboarding ideas (50 steps, auto-playing videos, mandatory surveys). Reverse-engineer to discover what NOT to do and refine best practices.

prompts.title: Constraint-Based Design
prompts.description: Design mobile app with constraints: 3 colors max, no images, 5-second load time. Force creative solutions and export minimalist design system as Tailwind config.

prompts.title: Cross-Functional Ideation
prompts.description: Facilitate workshop with designers, developers, and PMs. Use dot voting, affinity mapping, and feasibility scoring. Export prioritized features as Jira epics with story points.
